# David Packer Reports Greasing The Groove With EMOM Sessions Worked Very Well For Front Lever

David Packer reports that greasing the groove with small EMOM sessions worked very well for front lever, producing the most ridiculous progress he has ever had. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- He did it five times a week, mixing small EMOM sessions along with greasing the groove. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He would do five or ten sets of five or ten minute EMOM, and might do that three times spaced out, like from five pm, seven pm, nine pm, very small and very light. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Then he also did another day which was weighted sets and reps normal, and also combos. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- The second time around using this method was much better for him. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "the second time around it was much better for me"
